remarks: Why pay rent when you can own this one bedroom starter condo in the heart of Santa Monica's creative office district? There's lots of vintage charm in this 720 square foot top floor corner unit, from the hardwood floors in the living area and bedroom to the classic tile in the bathroom and kitchen to the open, landscaped courtyard where neighbors exchange pleasantries and look out for each other. Step inside to find a thoughtfully designed living space with ample natural light, creating a cozy yet open atmosphere that flows into a compact but efficient kitchen (buyers will need to install a range and refrigerator).
